audience.psychographics: Byron wellness and yoga community plus music fans and families: sunrise yoga, cacao ceremonies, Party Pilates, breathwork, sound healing and kids' yoga by day, live music (Boy & Bear, YAIMA, Kim Churchill, Cinnamon Sun) and a silent disco by night, with 60+ conscious market stalls and food trucks.
